comments.author: @ranasharma2302

comments.text:
Pre existing diseases are the ones which are known to the policy holder before buying the policy.

If BP  is diagnosed after 1 year,  the insured must have consulted doctor when he/ she got diagnosed with BP and medications would have been started on doctor's prescription.

At the time of claim, insurance company will ask for doctor consultation / prescription paper. If the same is available, there will be no issues at the time of claim.

comments.text: Let's suppose I got a pre existing disease which I myself am not aware while buying the policy. Let's also suppose the max waiting period for that disease is 3 years. So if I get hospitalized/treated coz of the same after 4 years, will the insurance company still reject my claim as I didn't 'mention' it in application or will it be fine as I already by then have crossed the waiting period?
comments.author: @kunalgoswami8647

comments.text:
Sir, pre existing disease is something which is known prior to the buying policy. Something that you are aware of and are taking treatment of the same.

Anything which is not known  does not count as PED.

Anything which is PED and not disclosed will not be automatically assumed to be covered after the PED waiting period is over.It needs to be disclosed if known.

comments.text:
Namsathe...I have been looking for health insurance policy for me spouse kid..
I would like to consider Aditya birla platinum enhanced plan of 4 lack with Max bupa health recharge 15 lack.
Apka opinion kya he..
Max bupa health recharge top up or super top up??
Please reply...thank you.

Sir, Firstly it is advisable to take base policy and super top up policy from the same insurer so as to avoid any delays in claims as once the claim for base sum assured is done, the top up company requires claim settlement letter and other documents to take the claim further.

If it is from the same company, it helps.

Better to take both policies from Aditya Birla - platinum enhanced + super health top.up 

Or 
Max bupa reassure + health recharge.
